definition.gain: final_synth_gain equals frozen envelope_02 synth_gain for every frame
definition.large_error: reference-voiced absolute audible frequency error >=100 cents
definition.one_two_frame_excursion: 300-cent departure from prior audio pitch returning within 100 cents after one or two frames
definition.settling: evaluation only: time until audible pitch stays within 80 cents of the later 128-384 ms frozen tracker median for four frames
